title: A simple self-assembly aptasensor for ultrasensitive detection of kanamycin based on carbon dots and Ti3C2 MXene nanocomposite
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11271-11282
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01006C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fang Li, Shuyue Xiong, Yijun Tan, Mingming Luo, Zijian Wu
A self-assembly aptasensor based on a two-round signal amplification strategy for kanamycin trace detection was demonstrated by employing carbon dot decorated Ti3C2 MXene as electrode modification material and the complex of double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) and methylene blue as probes.
